patch.value: Implement and certify the first local release of pm-reduce.
Six CLI and SDK operations share strict schemas; exact journal and replay; qualified certificates; native guarded writes; public reproduction evidence; full release gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implements companion specification pm-cli-website-2glk (read only). One native owner holds reduction state, trial journal and durable operation identities. Caller executes the oracle. Scaffold is isolated on main; implementation is on feat/reduce. No external publication is authorized.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Preflight evidence: full suite passed 35/35 with complete production instrumentation at 100 percent statements, branches, functions and lines; later focused checks cover strengthened host capability and certificate validation. Packed npm/Bun, npx/bunx, Git-absent transports and SDK imports passed the captured-artifact rehearsal. Final committed candidate will run both full release checks sequentially with unchanged thresholds. SDK transport limitation is isolated in reduce-sdk-transport; package fallback flags satisfy the delivered contract.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Read-only overlap audit confirms boundaries: pm-evidence owns citation freshness and source support; pm-hypothesis owns explanation admission and discriminating observations; pm-http owns declared HTTP requests and response observations. Reduction search, durable trial intent/outcomes and qualified deletion certificates remain pm-reduce-owned. No source package, task status or assurance verdict is modified by domain commands.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text: Orchestrator fix for CodeRabbit PRRT_kwDOVlPkts61MaLN (IMPORTANT): scripts/pack-gate.ts spawns npm.cmd through a shell on win32 (fixed arguments, no user input), so pack:dry-run works on Windows; POSIX unchanged. pack-gate 44 allowlisted files; 'package enumeration' focused test passes; typecheck clean.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text: Orchestrator fix for CodeRabbit PRRT_kwDOVlPkts61QeVr (IMPORTANT): guardSubmitted bounded visits, not array length, so a sparse new Array(2 ** 31) passed and schema validation would walk every slot before .max(64). Arrays longer than 32768 are now refused with the traversal-limit refusal before validation. Regression 'privacy traversal bounds sparse array length before schema validation walks it' (2^31 and 32769 refused, 64 allowed, parse refuses) fails on revert and passes restored; privacy suite 12/12.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text: Orchestrator fix for CodeRabbit PRRT_kwDOVlPkts61R5zj (IMPORTANT): the stored reduce.output_budget was evaluated eagerly as the fallback argument, so an invalid stored value (0, -1, 1.5, 8193) refused a command with a valid explicit --budget. The stored value is now read only when no explicit budget is given. Regression 'an explicit budget is not refused by an invalid stored budget setting' (explicit 1600 succeeds; without a budget the invalid setting is still refused) fails on revert, passes restored; contracts suite 14/14.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text: Class follow-up (CodeRabbit on pm-screen PRRT_kwDOVll0Ws61TTim): the per-array cap from bf3dff0 still let many sparse arrays below it add up. Holes (length minus present entries) are now charged to the existing 32768 work budget. 16 x 4096 holes are refused; the full suite passes 79/79; the aggregate case fails against the per-array-cap version and passes restored.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text: Class closure (CodeRabbit on pm-unit PRRT_kwDOVk5Fqc61W0uO and pm-screen PRRT_kwDOVll0Ws61W80k): charging holes by Object.keys was fooled by named properties, and a hole let schema validation read values inherited from Array.prototype. Arrays are now accepted only when their keys are exactly 0..length-1, and the length is checked against the 32768 work budget before the keys are listed. 'privacy traversal accepts only dense JSON arrays within the work budget' fails against the holes-charge version; full suite 79/79.

value.author: claude-orchestrator
value.text: Orchestrator fix: CI failed only the 0% duplication gate, with one 3-line clone pair (test/contracts.test.ts:114-116 <-> 129-131: the repeated provisioned fixture + extension harness setup that the explicit-budget regression added next to the settings-range test). Both now use a local harnessFixture(t, def). duplication 0/3137, typecheck and lint clean, changelog:check ok, full npm test 79 pass / 0 fail.

value.author: codex-smallfix2-1110
value.text: Review follow-up: derive the definition trial ceiling from journal capacity and prove replay leaves stored observation count unchanged. Validate boundary admission, corpus regressions, typecheck, lint and bounded full suite.

value.author: codex-smallfix2-1110
value.text: Both full review findings verified. Shared REPLAY_RECEIPT_CAPACITY derives MAX_TRIALS; schema and mutation capacity checks share the constants. Budget 255 runs to search completion; 256 is refused before creation. Corpus replay now checks stored observations before and after. Synthetic public snapshots and matching metrics regenerated for the admitted budget. Revert proof: restoring only DefinitionSchema max_trials to 256 makes the declared trial ceiling test fail with Missing expected rejection: proof:trial_ceiling (exit 1). Injecting a valid additional recorded observation on replay makes the beads corpus regression fail at proof:replay_observation_count (exit 1); both mutations restored. Typecheck and lint passed.
